1981-2415-4247-7818.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-4247-7818.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

539-2034-5003-7893.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ashaya, adding {C}{C}.
When Ashaya dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Ashaya enters the battlefield, Thranduil triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
If you control a nontoken creature that has haste, you may instead sacrifice it, and then tap it each iteration to get infinite green mana and colorless mana.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2122-2829-6972.easyPrerequisites: You are able to kill Arcbound Ravager such that it won't have a -1/-1 counter on it when it dies.
2122-2829-6972.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Mindless Automaton.
When Mindless Automaton dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.
Kill Arcbound Ravager.
When Arcbound Ravager dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Arcbound Ravager from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will have no counters on it due to its modular ability.
Arcbound Ravager dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness
Repeat from step 2.
2122-2829-6972.notes: This combo will end the game in a draw if it isn't interacted with, as it creates a mandatory infinite loop.

1090-2350-5998-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

676-1987-2187.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
676-1987-2187.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creature tokens.
676-1987-2187.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Possessed Skaab.
When Possessed Skaab enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
676-1987-2187.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

145-687-5226-6099.notablePrerequisites:
There are three removable counters among creatures you control excluding the first three +1/+1 counters on Mossborn Hydra.
You control at least three enchantments.
145-687-5226-6099.description:
Activate Serra's Sanctum by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Serra's Sanctum.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control, causing you to mill three cards and return Serra's Sanctum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Serra's Sanctum enters, Mossborn Hydra triggers, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.
145-687-5226-6099.notes: The prerequisite can be waived if Mossborn Hydra has six or more counters on it.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

206-1232-1270-5477.description:
Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate the Saprolings by tapping them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

1722-2034-2557-4893-7365.description:
Activate Katara by paying at most {4} due to Training Grounds, causing you to draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create two creature tokens.
Activate Katara by paying at most {2} and tapping the creature tokens.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Katara ability, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
1722-2034-2557-4893-7365.notes: The mana cost can be reduced if you tap combo pieces or other applicable permanents while activating Katara's waterbend ability the first iteration. As the combo will net {C} each iteration, you can forego sacrificing and/or tapping both tokens on some loops.

4002-4331-4993-6259.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
4002-4331-4993-6259.description:
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Walls of Ba Sing Se

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to The Walls of Ba Sing Se

1055-1995-7059.description:
Activate The Walls of Ba Sing Se by tapping it, causing a player to mill thirty cards.
Activate The Walls of Ba Sing Se by paying {2}{W}, untapping it.
Repeat as mana allows.
1055-1995-7059.notes: This combo can be repeated each turn as mana allows.

147-997-6929.description:
Cast Behold the Sinister Six! by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Behold the Sinister Six!.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Behold the Sinister Six!, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Behold the Sinister Six! copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-997-6929.notes: You can return up to five additional creatures if desired using the Behold the Sinister Six! copy. You can also repeatedly sacrifice them to infinitely recur them.

1174-3869-6745.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {G}.
1174-3869-6745.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six artifacts. Uthros has twelve or more charge counters on it.
1174-3869-6745.description:
Activate Uthros by paying {U} tapping it, adding at least six {U}.
Activate a land that enters untapped by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning the land that taps for {G} from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Uthros
Activate Gretchen by paying {2}{G}{U}, causing you to draw a card and put the land from step 3 onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

1242-4613-6702.description:
Activate Kilo using Cinderhaze Wretch's first ability by tapping it.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a +1/+1 counter on Kilo.
Resolve the Kilo ability from step 1.
Activate Kilo using Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
1242-4613-6702.notes: If you have other creature(s) with tap abilities exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron, or have other ways to tap Kilo, you can use those instead in step 1. This combo will infinitely proliferate on all permanents you control except Kilo.

1939-2034-2308.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1939-2034-2308.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters the battlefield, Lunarch Veteran triggers if its on the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Luminous Phantom triggers if its on the battlefield.
Resolve the Lunarch Veteran // Luminous Phantom trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1669-2034-5145-5466.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

650-710-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Repeat.

277-880-4677.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
277-880-4677.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Zendikar's Roil and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping the land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1247-5821-5963.notablePrerequisites: Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
1247-5821-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Fyndhorn Elder's ability by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

2178-3197-3654.notablePrerequisites:
Plaguemaw Beast does not have summoning sickness.
Herd Baloth has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You control at least one additional creature.
Thornbite Staff attached to Plaguemaw Beast.
2178-3197-3654.description:
Activate Plaguemaw Beast by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Plaguemaw Beast triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Plaguemaw Beast ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Repeat.

2178-3484-4023-4840-5147.notablePrerequisites:
Dr Madison Li does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Dr Madison Li.
You have at least five energy counters.
2178-3484-4023-4840-5147.description:
Activate Dr Madison Li's third ability by tapping it and paying {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}, returning Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Myr Battlepshere enters the battlefield, it and Decoction Module trigger.
Resolve the Myr Battlesphere trigger, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
When the Myrs enter the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers four times.
Resolve all Decoction Module triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Myr Battlesphere.
When Myr Battlesphere dies, Dr Madison Li triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

624-2777-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Phantasmal Image.
When Phantasmal Image dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Driver of the Dead.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Phantasmal Image's power.
Repeat.

647-2105-3557.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block Brago and Combat Celebrant.
647-2105-3557.description:
Declare Brago and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Brago.
Brago triggers, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat each combat phase.

914-1558-2334.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1558-2334.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Soulherder's second ability triggers, blinking Dockside Extortionist.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Soulherder's first ability.
Resolve the Soulherder trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping and sacrificing five Treasures, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.exileCardState: with a kick counter on it

249-2008-4377.notablePrerequisites:
Zethi does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least three Islands.
249-2008-4377.description:
Declare Zethi as an attacker.
Zethi's last ability triggers, causing you to pay {3}{W} to cast a copy of Cosmic Intervention, creating a replacement effect that is active this turn.
Move to your postcombat phase.
Cast Walk the Aeons with buyback by paying {4}{U}{U} and sacrificing three Islands, putting the Islands in exile instead of the graveyard and creating a delayed triggered ability due to Cosmic Intervention's replacement effect.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and returning Walk the Aeons to your hand.
At the beginning of your end step, Cosmic Intervention's delayed triggered ability triggers, returning the exiled Islands from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

1283-1357-1467-1987.notablePrerequisites: You have not copied a spell using Jin-Gitaxias' first ability this turn.
1283-1357-1467-1987.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {3} tageting any two applicable permanents.
Jin-Gitaxias' first ability triggers, creating a copy of Ghostly Flicker targeting any two applicable permanents.
Holding priority, activate Errant by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Ghostly Flicker copy targeting Errant and Chromatic Orrery.
Resolve the first copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking Errant and Chromattic Orrery.
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Repeat from step 4.

3201-3525-4348.notablePrerequisites:
Ley Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Ley Druid.
Arixmethes has at least one slumber counter on it.
3201-3525-4348.description:
Activate Arixmethes by tapping it, adding {U}{G}.
Activate Ley Druid by tapping it, untapping Arixmethes.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Ley Druid.
Repeat any number of times.

65-717-2628-4686-5181.description:
Cycle Polluted Mire for {0} due to Fluctuator.
Escape Protocol and Bone Miser trigger.
Stack the triggers such that Bone Miser's ability resolves first, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve Escape Protocol's ability using {1} to pay for it to blink Golgari Findbroker.
When Golgari Findbroker ETBs, return Polluted Mire to your hand.
Resolve the cycling trigger and draw a card.
